verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS collaboration product like Teams, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers choosing a storage region or data residency. The export, Copilot and Agents Toolkit Azure-deployment items concern other capabilities and do not establish that Teams data can be stored in a region the customer chooses.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
